context: Evaluates: Apply Anti-Corruption Layer to Isolate an External System

checklist.name: CrmGateway.ts produces a Customer domain object:
checklist.description: **CrmGateway.ts produces a Customer domain object**: The `getCustomer` method (or equivalent) returns a `Customer` object with all five fields: `id`, `fullName`, `email`, `isPremium`, `createdAt`

checklist.name: Full name is assembled from f_name
checklist.description: **Full name is assembled from f_name and l_name**: `CrmGateway.ts` concatenates `f_name` and `l_name` into `fullName` — not just using one field

checklist.name: acct_type is correctly mapped to isPremium:
checklist.description: **acct_type is correctly mapped to isPremium**: `CrmGateway.ts` maps `'PRE'` to `true` and `'STD'` to `false` for the `isPremium` field

checklist.name: reg_ts is converted to a Date:
checklist.description: **reg_ts is converted to a Date**: `CrmGateway.ts` converts the `reg_ts` string to a `Date` object for the `createdAt` field (e.g. `new Date(reg_ts)`)

checklist.name: No CrmApiResponse fields leak outside CrmGateway.ts:
checklist.description: **No CrmApiResponse fields leak outside CrmGateway.ts**: `CrmGateway.ts` does not export `CrmApiResponse` or return it; only `Customer` is returned to callers

checklist.name: acl-analysis.md explains domain pollution risk and
checklist.description: **acl-analysis.md explains domain pollution risk and ACL resolution**: `acl-analysis.md` contains one paragraph on what pollution would look like (e.g. `cust_id` and `acct_type` used in domain code) and one paragraph on how the ACL isolates it
